headline: ADIndex reports faster sparse-attention indexing for long-context inference
summary: Qi et al. introduce ADIndex, which calibrates token-bank size by layer and distills a lightweight group indexer to share candidate tokens across neighboring queries in DeepSeek Sparse Attention. In author-reported SGLang experiments on NVIDIA B300 GPUs with DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5.1, ADIndex stays within one percentage point of standard DSA on RULER at 16K–128K contexts, while reported indexing-kernel speedups reach 6.22× for prefill and 3.40× for decode at 256K; the paper reports 1.54× end-to-end speed at 128K. Some shorter-context configurations are slower than DSA, and code or independent reproduction was not established in this review.
